retrievalProfile.description: A dense, maximalist surrealist collage featuring a central figure atop a musical instrument surrounded by a chaotic menagerie of anthropomorphic creatures and miniature worlds.

recipe.visualDefinition: A vibrant, hyper-detailed illustration characterized by a central human figure in theatrical costume straddling a grand piano, set against a sunset sky and surrounded by a dense, Bosch-like assembly of hybrid animals, miniature cities in glass bowls, and floating objects.
coreVisualRelationships: Central figure acts as the vertical axis for a chaotic radial composition
Warm sunset background contrasts with cool-toned central clothing
Scale shifts between giant creatures and miniature urban environments
Dense layering creates a shallow but highly detailed depth of field
coreInvariants: Anthropomorphic hybrid creatures with expressive, human-like eyes
A central musical instrument integrated into the character's pose
A glass vessel containing a miniature architectural scene at the base

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Large central figure in a blue suit and top hat, occupying the upper-middle third of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The grand piano and the glass bowl at the bottom center provide structural stability.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Circular flow starting from the top-left title, moving down through the creatures on the left, across the bottom bowl, and up through the right-side figures.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Extremely limited; small pockets of orange sunset sky at the top provide the only visual relief.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Earth tones and muted browns for the creature crowd
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Vibrant blue for the central figure's suit
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Bright red and yellow for the primary display typography
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the foreground elements against a glowing, low-value sunset background.

letterConstructionRules: Heavy drop shadows to create 3D depth
Curvilinear baselines following the top edge
characterSpecificRedesigns: The 'F' and 'C' in the main title feature elongated, pointed terminals
Secondary text uses a blocky, arched slab-serif style
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Contrast a large, ornate serif title with smaller, blocky slab-serifs and fluid script accents.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the blocky slab-serif secondary text

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a dense surrealist painting in the style of Hieronymus Bosch but with 1970s airbrush techniques. Include a central man in a blue suit on a piano, surrounded by hybrid animals and a glass bowl containing a city at the bottom.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Apply a large, arched decorative serif title across the top with a red-to-yellow gradient and a heavy black drop shadow. Add secondary blocky text in the lower right corner.

verificationChecks: Is the main title arched and 3D?
Are there at least 10 distinct hybrid creatures?
Is the central figure wearing a top hat and goggles?
Does the bottom center feature a glass bowl with a city inside?

adjustableVariables: Color of the central figure's suit
postGenerationChecks: Ensure no modern digital artifacts are present
Verify the 3D depth of the typography
Check that the creatures look like hand-painted hybrids
Confirm the central figure is the clear focal point
recipe.reuseFormula: Maximalist Surrealism + 70s Airbrush + Central Theatrical Figure + Dense Creature Menagerie
